ns2:section.sectionText: In this course, you will learn how to be the driving force behind transformation, no matter your role. Becoming a change catalyst means mastering the art of influencing people, rallying support, and managing resistance within an organizational culture. You’ll leave this class with the knowledge to lead and thrive in any environment, setting yourself apart as a leader ready to tackle the future head-on.
